# Theme Builder libraries

These unmodified browser bundles are included locally so rendering and ZIP export do not depend on third-party CDN availability. The script integrity values in ../index.html are unchanged. Source archive and script hashes are recorded in provenance.json.

- Lucide 1.16.0: dist/umd/lucide.min.js; license in lucide-license-0.txt.
- JSZip 3.10.1: dist/jszip.min.js; license and bundled attribution in jszip-license-0.txt and jszip-license-1.txt.
